Desserts

Protein Pumpkin Cinnamon Rolls

Soft pumpkin-spiced rolls with a tangy yogurt and cream-cheese glaze. Bake a batch, keep it chilled, and warm one up for an easy sweet breakfast or dessert.

Prep
Not listed
Cook
Not listed
Total
1 hr 30 min
Difficulty
Not listed
Ingredients
11

Ingredients

  • 3 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1 cup pumpkin purée, warmed
  • 1½ cups nonfat Greek yogurt, divided
  • 2 scoops vanilla protein powder
  • 1 packet instant yeast
  • 1 large egg
  • 4 tbsp butter, divided
  • ⅓ cup + 2 tbsp coconut sugar
  • 2 oz light cream cheese
  • ½ cup powdered sugar
  • Cinnamon, pumpkin-pie spice and a pinch of salt

Amounts are scaled from 16 original servings. Season to taste.

Instructions

  1. Warm the pumpkin purée. Mix flour, protein powder, yeast, pumpkin-pie spice and a pinch of salt. Add the warm pumpkin, 1 cup yogurt, egg and 2 tbsp melted butter.
  2. Knead for about 5 minutes, until smooth. Cover and leave somewhere warm for about 1 hour, until doubled.
  3. Roll into a large rectangle. Spread with the remaining 2 tbsp butter, then scatter over the coconut sugar and cinnamon.
  4. Roll up tightly and cut into 16 rolls. Arrange in a lined baking pan and bake at 350°F for 22–25 minutes, until golden.
  5. Whisk the cream cheese, remaining ½ cup yogurt and powdered sugar into a glaze. Spread over the warm rolls.

Cook times may vary when changing batch size.
